title: AstroTransit Discovery Portfolio: Vetted Non-TOI Temperate Exoplanet Candidates from TESS Photometry (v2 Verified)
description: Strictly vetted evidence package containing empirical MCMC parameter estimations, FPP vetting reports, and 300 DPI light curve fits for verified Class A Non-TOI exoplanet candidates discovered from TESS photometry using AstroTransit.
